title: Inter-Como won't end 1-0 — 20 goals in six meetings
caption: Inter host Como at San Siro on Sunday and these two do not do goalless: 20 goals between them in their last six meetings, per Corriere dello Sport. UEFA named Yann Bisseck in its Champions League team of the week — next to the Como striker he has to stop. https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/tt/?ed=66 #Inter #InterComo #SerieA #Bisseck
